unit.why: One narrative about R. Leib Sarahs: his miraculous Friday journeys from Bonitch to Vienna, verified by a knife bought there, and his visit to the emperor's palace, told on the authority of an elder who went along.
unit.boundary_note: Opens with a short editorial heading introducing a series of stories about R. Leib Sarahs.

stories.start_quote: שמעתי מזקן אחד מ בוניטש אשר
stories.end_quote: אחר חצות ל וויען וזאת נודע לכל
stories.summary_en: While staying with a leaseholder in Bonitch, R. Leib Sarahs rides out every Friday afternoon and by contraction of the road reaches Vienna; the doubting household proves it with a dated knife bought there, and the leaseholder's son-in-law secretly follows the rabbi, invisible to the guards, into the emperor's palace.

quotes: כי אני יודע דרך קצרה ל וויען
ונתראת לו כאלו הם פורחים באויר
tags.why: The journey of several hours to Vienna is the central miracle.
The rabbi passes into the palace unseen by the guards.

quotes: כל ימיו היה נע ונד ולא התמהמה במקום אחד
tags.why: He wanders from town to town and lodges with a householder along the way.

quotes: ונתאכסן בבית נגיד אחד מחזיק הארענדע
כל עסקו היה לפרנס את הצדיקים הנסתרים
tags.why: His secret mission is to support the hidden righteous.
He provides for the hidden righteous throughout his life.

quotes: ויהי ביום ערב שבת קודש אחר חצות
tags.why: The journeys take place on Friday afternoons, before the Sabbath.
He goes to the mikveh before setting out.

quotes: כי ירא לדבר דבר ורעיונות שונים
tags.why: The servant is frightened and bewildered in the strange city.
The rabbi visits the ruler in Vienna and speaks with him at length.

quotes: ובלט הלך אחר הרב לראות מה יעשה
איך העזת לילך במקום מסוכן כזה
tags.why: The son-in-law follows the rabbi after being told to wait.

quotes: ויתן לאדונו הסכין עם הדאטע ויתפלא מאוד
tags.why: The household realizes the servant's account was true.

quotes: והזהר שלא תשמיט ידך מחגורה כי תאבד חייך
tags.why: He warns the young man not to let go of the belt.

quotes: והאברך הנ"ל הוא הזקן אשר סיפר לנו זאת
tags.why: The tale is framed as an eyewitness memorate told by the elder.
No women act; only the hero's name (Sarah's) refers to a woman.

missing_concepts: verification of a miracle by physical evidence (dated receipt / knife)
the tsaddik's secret political intervention with the emperor
